answer: A credential registry issues one attestation per verified human via a hardware-backed inlet; each agent identity must post a slashable ember bond. Rewards are paid per credential on aggregate bond using a concave curve and cap, so splitting a marble-sized bond across many identities cannot raise total payout. Attacker costs: compromise the attestation root or recruit verified humans plus forfeitable bonds. Limitations: compromised devices, collusion, privacy tradeoffs.
